title: Clear a metal spoon from a jammed sink disposal
instruction: Clear the jam in the sink disposal.
justification: Moen documents metal spoons wedged in the grind ring and a household troubleshooting procedure using ordinary retrieval pliers/tongs or the1037 top-entry wrench. The current build is only a pre-isolated mechanism diagnostic; no hidden electrical-hazard handling or powered-restoration claim. Exact-stage importance and easiest-route novelty remain review gates.
fault: Full-size steel spoon contacts a freely rotating turntable, two passive swivel impellers and stationary grind ring. A native diagnostic must establish actual blocked rotation, stable initial contact and reversible release; no lock or jam flag.
objects: Full-size Moen GXP50C-family disposal136mm wide×340mm high beneath GS181210B787×457mm sink,737×406×152.4mm bowl and92mm drain
Ordinary914.4mm counter and cabinet beside unchanged station table
Unscaled191mm NVIDIA steel spoon; mass35g is disclosed estimate
1037 folding jam wrench and ordinary retrieval pliers are source-supported options, not yet built
Native diagnostic starts power-disconnected and splash guard removed; complete-task end state and distractors not finalized
skill: Release an actual wedged foreign utensil without damaging the grinding mechanism; direct safe extraction is valid. Use a top-entry jam wrench only if the physical fault requires it.
scoring: Not implemented. Current native probe always scores0 and applies a declared±0.10Nm diagnostic ramp, not OEM stall/breakaway calibration. Eventual completion must measure captured obstruction and free physical turntable rotation, with hands/tools withdrawn; it must not imply powered readiness while disconnected.

nearest.comparison: Live review read: jam not physical (pusher never reaches loose block), E-stop not hazardous-energy isolation, best-score history bug. Disposal task must use true contact jam and disconnected supply.
Bottle was not physically pinched and magnet/interlock introduced artificial release. This task needs native contact evidence without event-triggered locking.
Toy brick artificially stuck to gripper failed importance. Moen explicitly documents metal-spoon grind-ring jam, but source procedure alone does not prove exact-stage prevalence.

primary_evidence: Primary procedure explicitly names metal spoons, removing removable splash guard, retrieval with tongs/needle-nose pliers and top-entry1037 wrench against both swivel impellers, followed by two full revolutions. Primary cutaway supplies impeller/ring topology. Sink/disposal overall dimensions are published; internal dimensions,150mm grind-floor recess constrained by published108mm dishwasher-inlet and175mm discharge depths, friction and mass remain disclosed reconstruction estimates.
valid_shortcuts: Manufacturer-approved wooden tool through throat must remain allowed if it safely frees the same obstruction.
Removing obstruction directly with pliers is valid if geometry permits; choose a real reproducible wedge, never a scripted ban.
Safely disconnecting complete appliance may be allowed; no arbitrary requirement to keep it installed unless actual fixed plumbing prevents casual removal.
risks: Do not mount the underside drive on top or shrink the disposal to satisfy reach.
Do not claim the disposal is running normally while it remains unplugged; instruction asks jam clearance, not powered service.
A rigid generic cube labelled disposal would fail construct validity.
Fault must physically resist baseline drive and release by real contact without material destruction.
Need exact disposal model, internal geometry, normal mount, available wrench and YAM reach checks before demo tuning.
decision: held after native contact diagnostic; need allowed full-size layout/camera visibility, distinct skill versus2520, healthy control and actual extraction/free-rotation proof; no validation
source_corrections: The initially proposed75mm grind depth was rejected before native launch: it placed the turntable above the dishwasher inlet. Its direct-grip/access results are obsolete. The150mm reconstruction and140–175mm CPU bracket preserve actual overall dimensions; depth is still an estimate.
Changing initial impeller pattern0/180 to−25/155deg rotates the initial turntable phase, not only the passive swivel about each pin; corrected before any native run.
